segments.title: Pepito Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour countdown and sign-on from the control room, identifying as the dog who produces the show.

segments.title: Jeffrey Newsman / Jeff Ripple News Desk
segments.notes: Case Blackwell adopts the 'Jeffrey Newsman' persona (parodying HBO's The Newsroom) and transitions into Jeff Ripple, riffing on generational discourse and thanking subscribers before Hype Train interrupts.

segments.title: Hype Train Derailment & Subscriber Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the broadcast for an extended freestyle over a Pop-Tart beat, thanking subscribers (Storn Lack, Uncle Phil, Jackpug1, Sporify, Cardkeena, Skymer) and attacking Jeff Ripple with targeted bars.

segments.title: Kendall Walk-Through: Blackpink Concert Recap
segments.notes: Kendall crosses the frame to her signature theme; she and Case discuss the Blackpink concert where Bruno Mars made a surprise appearance, then departs after chat commentary drives her off.

segments.title: Merch Show-and-Tell: Blackpink Sweatpants & Light Stick
segments.notes: Kendall returns to model Blackpink tour merch (sweatpants, light-up hammer, shirt); chat guesses the price via poll (winner: Sporefight at $230 including hammer).

segments.title: ICE Raid Fatality & Alligator Alcatraz Conditions
segments.notes: Case covers the first confirmed death during a Trump-era ICE raid (California farm worker James Alana) and the Democratic lawmaker tour of Florida's 'Alligator Alcatraz' detention facility, highlighting toilet-fountain combos, overcrowding, and flooding.

segments.title: Trailer Watch: Corn Dog Man, Who Killed Captain Alex, Durandar, Zigfield Follies
segments.notes: Case and chat watch viewer-submitted trailers: Sundance's 'Corn Dog Man' (blackface twist), Ugandan action 'Who Killed Captain Alex?', Indian 'Durandar', and a micro-budget 'Zigfield Follies'.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon News Blast & Intern Julie Grace Introduction
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon emerges from the wall for a 'bi-daily news blast'; Monday intern Julie Grace is introduced, reveals she's earning college credits, and fields chat questions about hair care and roommates.

segments.title: Rapid-Fire News Roundup with Peter Gibbon
segments.notes: Peter and Case blast through stories: Epstein surveillance video metadata anomalies, AI gallbladder surgery on mannequin, Conor McGregor nudes leaked by Azealia Banks, Tesla robotaxi penis-shaped service area, Chris Cuomo third-party campaign video, freeze branding trend, Florida man fired from Alligator Alcatraz, Courtney Kardashian enema advice, Comcast/CAA funding 'ethical' AI video startup, Ghislaine Maxwell client list, pig-costumed ICE protester, McDonald's McHire password vulnerability, and Earth's expiration in 2 billion years.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid
segments.notes: Case apologizes for limited intern interaction, plugs Monday return, attempts a song for Julie Grace, and raids Christine while Peter shouts over the sign-off.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell opens as a Newsroom parody before Hype Train hijacks the broadcast with a Pop-Tart freestyle. Kendall walks through twice — first for a Blackpink concert recap with surprise Bruno Mars, then for a merch reveal settled by chat poll. The news block covers the first confirmed ICE raid death and horrific conditions at Florida's Alligator Alcatraz. A trailer watch segment reviews Corn Dog Man, Who Killed Captain Alex, and micro-budget oddities. Peter Gibbon emerges from the wall for a news blast alongside new Monday intern Julie Grace, followed by a rapid-fire round spanning Epstein metadata, AI surgery, McGregor nudes, Tesla's phallic map, and Earth's 2-billion-year deadline.
